show_title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke

promos.hook: Juliana's tearful expression transforms into a steely, defiant smile.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana declares she leaves the chapel with her head held high while Gerald stands stunned and speechless.
promos.why_it_works_draft: Delivers an immensely satisfying emotional reversal where the humiliated heroine seizes total control of the room with an empowering speech.
promos.blind_clip_script:
[B054 01:14.20-01:16.50] CAMERA: Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.
[B055 01:14.40-01:16.40] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA [Bitter, Defiant]: "Dignity?"
[B056 01:16.50-01:19.00] CAMERA: Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

[B059 01:19.20-01:22.50] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) [Sharp, Piercing]: "...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth." [SENT_GRP:3]

[B061 01:22.80-01:26.70] CAMERA: Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.
[B062 01:23.00-01:26.50] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA [Steely, Resolute]: "Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald."
[B063 01:26.70-01:30.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.
[B064 01:26.80-01:33.00] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA [Powerful, Unyielding]: "You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable."

[B066 01:33.20-01:36.80] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.
[B067 01:33.40-01:36.60] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA [Decisive, Scathing]: "You have shown them exactly what your word is worth."
[B068 01:36.80-01:38.20] CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
[B069 01:38.20-01:42.80] CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
[B070 01:38.20-01:42.80] ACTION: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.
[B071 01:38.50-01:42.40] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA [Resolute, Proud]: "I may leave this chapel without a husband..." [SENT_GRP:4]
[B072 01:42.80-01:50.00] CAMERA: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.
[B073 01:43.00-01:47.40] DIALOGUE | LADY JULIANA [Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit]: "...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed." [SENT_GRP:4]
[B074 01:47.40-01:50.00] ACTION: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.
promos.why_it_works: The protagonist's sudden shift from victimhood to fierce, articulate defiance makes for a satisfying emotional reversal.
promos.honest_critique: The hook relies on a single shouted word rather than physical action, which may not stop hard scrolling immediately.

promos.hook: Lady Ashcroft violently rips Juliana's treasured mother's ledger out of her hands and flings it into the mud.
promos.cliffhanger: The mysterious scarred husband gives Gerald a lethal, chilling warning before walking away with Juliana.
promos.why_it_works_draft: Combines raw public humiliation and betrayal by family with an instant badass protective power move by the new husband.
promos.spoiler_reason: Shows Juliana being formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance.

[B047 01:20.50-01:22.00] DIALOGUE | JULIANA [Choked, Weeping]: "They destroyed it."
[B048 01:22.50-01:25.40] DIALOGUE | MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Calm, Grounded]: "They dirtied it. That is not the same thing."

[B050 01:26.50-01:27.80] DIALOGUE | JULIANA [Broken]: "It was my mother's."

[B058 01:38.00-01:40.80] DIALOGUE | MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Low, Lethally Cold]: "Choose your next words carefully."
[B059 01:41.50-01:45.50] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand completely covering and protecting Juliana's hands where they clasp the book.
[B060 01:44.20-01:45.20] DIALOGUE | MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Soft, Reassuring]: "Come."
promos.why_it_works: Physical destruction of a mother's keepsake paired with a mysterious protector stepping in provides strong genre-pleasing tropes.
promos.honest_critique: The ending fizzles out with a soft line instead of an explosive narrative hook.

promos.hook: The priest pronounces Juliana and the scarred warrior husband and wife as dramatic music swells.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana and her new husband walk hand-in-hand through the massive oak doors into the bright sunlight, turning their backs on her disowning family.
promos.why_it_works_draft: Delivers ultimate emotional payoff, public humiliation of toxic exes, and a triumphant walkout into freedom.
promos.spoiler_reason: Shows Juliana being formally disowned and married to the stranger.

promos.why_it_works: A brand new wedding twist followed by total disownment creates high-stakes drama that leaves viewers wanting to see what happens next.
promos.honest_critique: Jumping straight into a second wedding without knowing who the new groom is causes initial confusion for a cold viewer.

promos.hook: Gerald callously abandons Juliana at the altar in front of the entire aristocratic congregation.
promos.cliffhanger: Clarissa mocks Juliana as a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
promos.why_it_works_draft: Instantly triggers outrage from the viewer against the arrogant groom and cruel sister, setting up an explosive revenge arc.

promos.honest_critique: It drags on through multiple repetitive insults without reaching a true narrative peak or cliffhanger.
